kinds.label: space station
caveats: Close approaches are SOCRATES predictions for one week, per existing object of this kind. They are not collision probabilities and not a forecast for a new satellite.
SOCRATES only lists pairs that include an active satellite, and same-constellation pairs are removed here, so constellations look quieter than other kinds partly by construction.
Near-polar orbits (about 97 degrees) cross many inclined constellations; that may explain high counts for imaging, weather, cubesat and science kinds, but it was not tested.
Kind labels are CelesTrak's group files; tracked objects only.
Space station means the ISS alone (one object), so its numbers are an example, not a statistic.
Only 1 objects of this kind; treat the averages loosely.
